import.title: Import and calibrate plan
import.private: Analysis and OCR run in this browser. The draft is saved to your project only after confirmation.
import.confirmReplacement: I understand this sheet's image and linked elements will be replaced; other sheets remain unchanged.
import.choose: Choose PDF or image · up to 12 MB
import.multiSheetHint: Import each PDF page and multiple files. A photo with two rooms is analyzed as one sheet with multiple spaces.
import.referenceOnly: This sheet is saved as a reference. Identify services or structural elements in the editor; its lines will not automatically become walls.
import.symbolProposalsHint: Inferred only from nearby labels. Check position, size and orientation before confirming.
editor.sourcesHint: Select a sheet to compare it with the model.
editor.sourcesEmpty: No sheets have been imported yet.
editor.reviewQueueHint: Open an element to check it against the drawing.
editor.latestEvidence: OCR and notices from the latest import
editor.evidence.caution: These clues do not verify the drawing; confirm each element before using the model.
editor.evidence.unavailable: This sheet predates page-level evidence storage. Check the original.
editor.evidence.warning.orthogonal-basel: Automatic detection covers orthogonal and 45° diagonal lines; verify irregular geometry manually.
editor.evidence.warning.text-proposals-r: Openings and stairs are suggested from OCR labels; position, size and orientation need review.
editor.evidence.warning.openings-require: Check doors and windows against the original drawing.
editor.evidence.warning.verify-source-di: Verify the assigned discipline and level.
editor.save.leaveWarning: There are unsaved changes. Leave and discard this draft?
editor.routeDisclaimer: Connect points on the same level and system. The 3D path is schematic, not a validated technical design.
model.routesHint: {count} schematic connections. The direct path is not an engineered pipe or circuit route.
model.servicesHint: Hover over a model marker to see its name.
import.fourPoints: Mark corners in order: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left.
import.twoPoints: Mark two points of a known distance in the image and enter its measurement in metres. A third click restarts selection.
import.wallHeight: Assumed wall height (m) · verify on site
import.ocr: Read text with local OCR (up to 2 min)
import.empty: Choose a plan to begin. PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP.
import.cancelled: Analysis cancelled or timed out. You can retry without OCR.
import.invalidFile: The document could not be read.
import.reviewHint: Blue: proposed walls. Green: enclosed rectangular spaces. They will be imported as a draft, not verified detections.
import.limitations: Preliminary detection for orthogonal drawings. Check lines, rooms, scale and symbols. Each page is assigned to the chosen level and discipline; existing geometry is kept by default.
import.replace: Replace existing geometry on this level when importing this sheet.
pm.create.demo: The file is kept as a document. Next, calibrate it and review the proposal in the import assistant. Without a file, the plan starts empty.
render.draft: Provisional view. Review geometry, heights and openings before using dimensions. The structural view is schematic, not an engineering calculation.
render.reviewed: Geometry reviewed by the user. This is not structural or regulatory validation.
render.note: Artistic lighting, not a georeferenced solar study. Preferences control resolution and shadows. Settings are stored per project in this browser.
